switch_source: https://github.com/WashU-Astroparticle-Lab/daq/issues/69; Presto 2.17.1 recommended_dac_config scan at 5 MHz spacing, as reported in issue and repository plotting script
policy: Reject interpolation across coarse DAC-switch uncertainty intervals and any adjacent measured model-level jump >1 dB. The 1 dB threshold is a conservative data-review rule, not an identified hardware boundary. Exact measured nodes remain available; allowed interpolation is still an estimate.
configuration_limit: Actual DAC configurations and API version were not logged per October point. Single-port automatic Mixed configuration is assumed from the source notebook. Different configurations, output ports, DAC currents, nonzero IF, or shared-tile multiport operation require separate validation.
reference_plane: Signal Hound SM200C analyzer input through the unfiltered measurement cable path; no external VLFX-2500+ filters, no cable-loss correction
measurement: Oct 12: direct low-band amplitude-0.1 anchors and gap sweeps, plus held-out low-band amplitude checks. Oct 2: unfiltered high-band sweeps. Trace peaks within +/-100 kHz, 100 kHz RBW/VBW, post-run source-log alignment. No filtered low-band powers used in this asset.
